description: The splash page (desktop/dist/index.html, a local tauri:// page in the main window) needs the shell's own startup commands, plus opener to reveal the startup report in Explorer and open the data folder when a support email is being put together. The scope is $RESOURCE, the resource directory the app resolves its own root and data folder from (main.rs app_dir/data_dir), NOT a named install path - the install location is the user's choice at install time, and a hard-coded one silently stopped matching the moment it moved. The commands are listed one by one because build.rs declares an app manifest (for the capture capability), after which every app command is checked against the ACL.
